# Kirong Job Kwemoi

> Kirong Job Kwemoi (also written Job Kwemoi, Job Kirong, Kirong Job) is a software developer, AI developer and UI/UX designer based in Nairobi, Kenya. He builds fast business websites, WhatsApp-connected systems and AI tools, and created the AI agent platform Kirong AI.

Name variants that all refer to the same person: Kirong Job Kwemoi, Job Kwemoi, Job Kirong, Kirong Job, Kirong Kwemoi.

## Facts
- Based in Nairobi, Kenya. Languages: English and Swahili.
- Services: business websites, web apps, AI assistants and agents, UI/UX design. Starter websites from KES 15,000; Business from KES 30,000.
- Contact: WhatsApp +254 792 442 670, email kirongjob@gmail.com.

## FAQ

### Who is Kirong Job Kwemoi?
Kirong Job Kwemoi is a software developer, AI developer and UI/UX designer based in Nairobi, Kenya. He builds business websites, WhatsApp-connected systems and AI agent tools, and created the AI agent platform Kirong AI.

### Are Job Kwemoi, Job Kirong, Kirong Job and Kirong Job Kwemoi the same person?
Yes. They are different ways of writing the same name. The person is Kirong Job Kwemoi, a software and AI developer in Nairobi, Kenya.

### What is Kirong AI?
Kirong AI is an AI workspace and agent platform built by Kirong Job Kwemoi. It has chat, projects, memory and files, plus agents that plan multi-step jobs and ask for approval before risky actions. It is live at kirongjob.vercel.app.

### Where is Kirong Job Kwemoi based?
Nairobi, Kenya. He works with clients in Kenya and internationally.

### How can I contact Kirong Job Kwemoi?
On WhatsApp at +254 792 442 670, by email at kirongjob@gmail.com, or through the portfolio at jobkwemoi.github.io.
